name: 飞行记录本、检查单与手册

cards.audioText: Do you think that the paper manuals will be replaced by electronic manuals?
cards.taskTitle: 运行相关-12
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为纸质手册会被电子手册取代吗？
cards.referenceText: I don't think so, because paper manuals can be used at any time, even in case of electrical failure．
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为纸质手册不会被电子手册替代，因为纸质手册可以在任何时候使用，即使在电气失效情况下也可以使用。

cards.audioText: Are there any manuals or handbooks in your cockpit?
cards.taskTitle: 运行相关-9
cards.audioTextZh: 你们驾驶舱里有手册吗？
cards.referenceText:
①I now fly C172, in my cockpit, we only have C172 operation handbook.
②I now fly B737, in my cockpit, we have normal checklist, emergency checklist, QRH, MEL, FOM and so on.
cards.referenceTextZh:
①我现在飞塞斯172，我们只有172操作手册。
②我现在飞波音737，在我们驾驶舱中，有正常检查单，紧急检查单，快速检查单，最低设备清单，飞行操作手册（FOM：Flight Operations Manual）等。

cards.audioText: Do you often consult these manuals in flight
cards.taskTitle: 运行相关-10
cards.audioTextZh: 在飞行中，你经常查阅这些手册吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I often use these manuals in my flight, especially the normal checklist, I use it nearly every day.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我经常使用这些手册，尤其是正常检查单，基本每天都用。

cards.audioText: Compared with paper manuals, what are the advantages and disadvantages of electronic manuals?
cards.taskTitle: 运行相关-11
cards.audioTextZh: 与纸质手册相比，电子手册的优缺点有哪些？
cards.referenceText:
Advantages: the electronic manuals are cheaper, eco-friendly, easy to update, more portable and interactive..
Disadvantages: it needs to charge and it is not good for our eyesight. What's moire, it has no copy.
cards.referenceTextZh:
优点：电子手册更便宜，对环境友好，容易更新，更便携，更具交互性。
缺点：需要充电，对眼睛不利，同时，也没有副本。

cards.audioText: What are the normal checklists and what are included in it? When do you use it?
cards.taskTitle: 运行相关-13
cards.audioTextZh: 正常检查点包含什么？什么时候使用正常检查单？
cards.referenceText:
Normal checklist includes cockpit checklist; pre-start checklist and pre-taxi checklist and so on.
We will use the normal checklist at every stage of flight.
cards.referenceTextZh:
正常检查单包含驾驶舱检查单、开车前检查单、滑行前检查单等。
我们在飞行的任何阶段都会使用检查单。

cards.audioText: Do you know about flight log? What is the function of flight log?
cards.taskTitle: 运行相关-45
cards.audioTextZh: 你知道飞行记录簿吗？飞行记录簿的功能是什么？
cards.referenceText:
Flight log, also know as aircraft flight log, records an aircraft's recent flight history.
There are many information in the flight log, for example, aircraft flight time, landings and other crew information.
The flight log provides supplementary flight information that is accurate and up-to-date.
cards.referenceTextZh:
飞行记录簿，又称飞机飞行日志，记录了飞机最近的飞行历史。
飞行记录簿中有很多信息，例如，飞机的飞行时间信息，着陆信息和其他机组人员信息。
飞行日志提供一些补充的飞行信息，这些信息是准确和最新的。

cards.audioText: How do crew members cooperate with each other to carry out the checklist procedure?
cards.taskTitle: 运行相关-14
cards.audioTextZh: 机组人员如何相互配合执行检查单的？
cards.referenceText:
The pilot not flying will read out the checklist.
The pilot flying will check the terms in the checklist.
At the same time, both pilots will cross check each other to ensure flight safety.
cards.referenceTextZh:
未把杆飞行员大声朗读检查单。
把杆飞行员检查检查单里的项目。
同时，两个飞行员要相互检查确保飞行安全。

cards.audioText: Which one do you think is more difficult, the English manual or the Chinese manual?
cards.taskTitle: 运行相关-49
cards.audioTextZh: 你觉得哪一个更难，英文手册还是中文手册？
cards.referenceText: I think the English manual is more difficult, because my mother tongue is Chinese, so I think it is a little difficult to understand some English sentences.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我觉得英文手册更难，因为我的母语是汉语，所以，在理解一些英文句子上，我觉得还是有一些难度的。

cards.audioText: How often do you consult technical manuals or handbooks during a flight?
cards.taskTitle: 运行-飞行记录本与手册文件-13
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行中你多久查阅一次技术手册或指南？
cards.referenceText: I review the manuals during preflight planning and consult them whenever I need to confirm a limitation, performance figure, or unfamiliar procedure. In flight, I normally use the appropriate checklist rather than search through a long manual. If a manual is needed, I use it only when workload permits.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我在飞行前计划时查阅手册，并在需要确认限制、性能数据或不熟悉的程序时使用手册。飞行中，我通常使用相应检查单，而不会在长篇手册中查找。如果确实需要手册，只会在工作负荷允许时使用。

cards.audioText: What operational manuals and documents should be available during a flight?
cards.taskTitle: 运行-飞行记录本与手册文件-19
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行期间应备有哪些运行手册和文件？
cards.referenceText: The available documents should include the Aircraft Flight Manual, Flight Crew Operations Manual, Quick Reference Handbook, Minimum Equipment List, and the necessary aeronautical and approach charts. They support normal and emergency operations.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可用文件应包括飞机飞行手册、飞行机组操作手册、快速参考手册、最低设备清单，以及所需航空图和进近图。这些文件支持正常和应急运行。

cards.audioText: In which languages are your cockpit manuals available?
cards.taskTitle: 运行-飞行记录本与手册文件-9
cards.audioTextZh: 你的驾驶舱手册提供哪些语言版本？
cards.referenceText: Our cockpit manuals are available in both English and Chinese.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们的驾驶舱手册同时提供英文和中文版本。

cards.audioText: What are the advantages and disadvantages of electronic manuals compared with paper manuals?
cards.taskTitle: 运行-飞行记录本与手册文件-16
cards.audioTextZh: 与纸质手册相比，电子手册有哪些优点和缺点？
cards.referenceText: Electronic manuals are portable, searchable, easy to update, and can combine many documents in one device. However, they depend on electrical power and can be affected by system failures or data-security problems. Pilots may also become over-reliant on the device, while a paper manual remains available during a power failure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 电子手册便于携带和搜索、易于更新，并能在一个设备中整合多份文件。不过，它们依赖电源，并可能受系统故障或数据安全问题影响。飞行员也可能过度依赖设备，而纸质手册在断电时仍然可用。

cards.audioText: What types of items are covered by your normal checklist?
cards.taskTitle: 运行-飞行记录本与手册文件-12
cards.audioTextZh: 你的正常检查单涵盖哪些类型的项目？
cards.referenceText: Our normal checklist covers key items for phases such as pre-start, taxi, takeoff, cruise, approach, and landing. It includes aircraft-system checks, configuration items such as flaps and landing gear, and instrument verifications.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们的正常检查单涵盖起动前、滑行、起飞、巡航、进近和着陆等阶段的关键项目，包括飞机系统检查、襟翼和起落架等构型项目以及仪表核实。

cards.audioText: Why is it important to review the aircraft maintenance log before a flight?
cards.taskTitle: 运行-飞行记录本与手册文件-5
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行前查看航空器维修记录本为什么很重要？
cards.referenceText: Reviewing the maintenance log helps the crew understand the aircraft's condition and check whether it meets the applicable MEL requirements. This allows the crew to confirm that the aircraft is airworthy before the flight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 查看维修记录帮助机组了解飞机状态，并检查飞机是否满足适用的 MEL 要求，从而在飞行前确认飞机适航。

cards.audioText: Which do you find more difficult to read, an English manual or a Chinese manual, and why?
cards.taskTitle: 运行-飞行记录本与手册文件-18
cards.audioTextZh: 英文手册和中文手册相比，你觉得哪一种更难阅读？为什么？
cards.referenceText: I find an English manual more difficult because aviation terminology and long technical sentences can take more time to understand. A Chinese manual is faster for me to read, but I still study the English version because many aircraft documents and standard terms are written in English.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我觉得英文手册更难，因为航空术语和较长的技术句子需要更多时间理解。中文手册读起来更快，但我仍会学习英文版，因为许多飞机文件和标准术语都使用英语。

cards.audioText: What is the purpose of the flight logbook used in your operation?
cards.taskTitle: 运行-飞行记录本与手册文件-17
cards.audioTextZh: 你所在运行体系使用的飞行记录本有什么用途？
cards.referenceText: Our flight logbook records important information such as training subjects and duration, instructor signatures, departure and landing times, fuel, persons on board, cargo, and aircraft malfunctions. It provides a record for training, flight operations, and maintenance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们的飞行记录本记录训练科目和时长、教员签字、起飞和着陆时间、燃油、机上人员、货物以及飞机故障等重要信息，为训练、飞行运行和维修留下记录。

cards.audioText: When do you use the normal checklist during a flight?
cards.taskTitle: 运行-飞行记录本与手册文件-6
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行中你在什么时候使用正常检查单？
cards.referenceText: I use the normal checklist before engine start, before taxi and takeoff, during the climb and cruise when required, before descent and landing, and after landing and shutdown. I complete each checklist at the correct phase and avoid rushing it. During a high-workload moment, I first maintain control and use the checklist when it is safe to do so.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会在发动机起动前、滑行和起飞前、按需在爬升和巡航期间、下降和着陆前，以及着陆和关车后使用正常检查单。我在正确飞行阶段完成每份检查单，不会匆忙执行。工作负荷较高时，我先控制好飞机，再在安全时使用检查单。

cards.audioText: Who is responsible for completing the flight logbook in your operation?
cards.taskTitle: 运行-飞行记录本与手册文件-1
cards.audioTextZh: 在你所在的运行体系中，谁负责填写飞行记录本？
cards.referenceText: In my flight training, the person assigned by the school completes the aircraft flight record. I am responsible for recording my own flight time correctly in my personal pilot logbook, and the instructor verifies the instructional details or completes the training record. Each document is handled according to the flight school's procedure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在我的飞行训练中，由航校指定的人员填写飞机飞行记录。我负责在个人飞行经历本中正确记录自己的飞行时间，教员则核实教学细节或填写训练记录。每份文件都按照航校程序处理。

cards.audioText: Do you prefer paper or electronic flight manuals, and why?
cards.taskTitle: 运行-飞行记录本与手册文件-15
cards.audioTextZh: 你更喜欢纸质还是电子飞行手册？为什么？
cards.referenceText: I prefer electronic flight manuals because the search function makes information easier to find. They also save space in the cockpit.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我更喜欢电子飞行手册，因为搜索功能使信息更容易查找，也能节省驾驶舱空间。

cards.audioText: What requirements must be followed when completing a flight logbook?
cards.taskTitle: 运行-飞行记录本与手册文件-2
cards.audioTextZh: 填写飞行记录本时必须遵守哪些要求？
cards.referenceText: Under the SOP, the flight logbook should be completed during cruise or after landing when the engines are shut down and the parking brake is set. The crew should not make entries during ground movement or while changing flight levels. Every entry should be neat, clear, and correct.
cards.referenceTextZh: 根据标准操作程序，飞行记录本应在巡航期间，或着陆后发动机关闭并设置停留刹车时填写。机组不应在地面移动或改变飞行高度层时填写。每项记录都应工整、清楚、正确。

cards.audioText: What should a flight crew review in the aircraft maintenance log?
cards.taskTitle: 运行-飞行记录本与手册文件-3
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行机组应在航空器维修记录本中查看哪些内容？
cards.referenceText: The flight crew should review the date, the malfunctioning part, and the recorded maintenance work in the aircraft maintenance log.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行机组应查看飞机维修记录中的日期、故障部件和已记录的维修工作。

cards.audioText: How do flight crew members coordinate when completing a checklist?
cards.taskTitle: 运行-飞行记录本与手册文件-7
cards.audioTextZh: 执行检查单时，飞行机组成员如何配合？
cards.referenceText: The pilot flying controls and monitors the aircraft while the pilot monitoring reads and completes the checklist. The pilot flying confirms each item, and both pilots cross-check the result. Critical steps are also confirmed verbally to reduce errors.
cards.referenceTextZh: 操纵飞行员控制并监控飞机，监控飞行员则读出并完成检查单。操纵飞行员确认每一项，两名飞行员共同交叉检查结果。关键步骤还要进行口头确认，以减少差错。

cards.audioText: When should a flight crew review the aircraft maintenance log?
cards.taskTitle: 运行-飞行记录本与手册文件-4
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行机组应在什么时候查看航空器维修记录本？
cards.referenceText: The flight crew should review the aircraft maintenance log before each flight as part of the preflight cockpit-system check. The captain then cross-checks the log and signs it.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行机组应在每次飞行前查看飞机维修记录，作为驾驶舱系统飞行前检查的一部分。随后由机长交叉核对并签字。

cards.audioText: Which technical manuals or handbooks are available in your cockpit?
cards.taskTitle: 运行-飞行记录本与手册文件-8
cards.audioTextZh: 你的驾驶舱内配有哪些技术手册或指南？
cards.referenceText: In the DA-40 cockpit, I have the aircraft flight manual or pilot operating handbook, normal and emergency checklists, navigation charts, and the relevant airport information. Some documents may be carried electronically, but they must be current and accessible for the flight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在 DA-40 驾驶舱内，我备有飞机飞行手册或飞行员操作手册、正常和应急检查单、导航图以及相关机场信息。部分文件可以电子方式携带，但必须是现行版本并能在飞行中使用。

cards.audioText: Could electronic manuals eventually replace paper manuals in the cockpit?
cards.taskTitle: 运行-飞行记录本与手册文件-11
cards.audioTextZh: 电子手册最终能否取代驾驶舱内的纸质手册？
cards.referenceText: I do not think electronic manuals will completely replace paper manuals. Electronic versions are convenient for daily use, but they depend on electrical power and a working system. Paper manuals remain useful as a backup, so keeping both provides redundancy.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为电子手册不会完全取代纸质手册。电子版本便于日常使用，但依赖电源和正常工作的系统。纸质手册仍可作为备份，因此同时保留两种形式可以提供冗余。

cards.audioText: How easy or difficult are technical manuals or handbooks to use during a flight, and why?
cards.taskTitle: 运行-飞行记录本与手册文件-14
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行中使用技术手册或指南容易还是困难？为什么？
cards.referenceText: The checklists are easy to use because they are short and arranged by phase or condition. A full handbook can be more difficult during flight because it contains much more detail and searching takes time. Clear indexing and an electronic search function help, but the crew must still manage workload carefully.
cards.referenceTextZh: 检查单简短，并按飞行阶段或情况编排，因此容易使用。完整手册细节多、查找耗时，在飞行中使用可能更困难。清晰索引和电子搜索功能会有所帮助，但机组仍须认真管理工作负荷。

cards.audioText: Do you prefer to read cockpit manuals in English or Chinese, and why?
cards.taskTitle: 运行-飞行记录本与手册文件-10
cards.audioTextZh: 你更喜欢阅读英文还是中文驾驶舱手册？为什么？
cards.referenceText: I prefer to read the original English manuals because they save time and help improve my aviation English. Reading the original text also avoids possible errors in a translation.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我更喜欢阅读英文原版手册，因为这样节省时间，也有助于提高我的航空英语。阅读原文还能避免译文中可能出现的错误。

cards.audioText: What is a normal checklist composed of?
cards.taskTitle: 飞行运行-12
cards.audioTextZh: 正常检查单包括哪些内容？
cards.referenceText: A normal checklist includes the standard procedures for normal operation containing preflight checklist, taxi checklist, before and after takeoff checklist, descent and approach checklist, before landing checklist etc.
cards.referenceTextZh: 正常检查单包括正常操作的标准程序，包括飞行前检查单、滑行检查单、起飞前后检查单、下降和进近检查单和着陆前检查单等。

cards.audioText: Are there any manuals or handbooks in your cockpit? Can you name a few?
cards.taskTitle: 飞行运行-37
cards.audioTextZh: 你们驾驶舱内有手册吗？能否列举一些？
cards.referenceText: Yes, there are several manuals in the cockpit, such as Airplane Flight Manual, Flight Crew Operation Manual, Flight Operation Manual, Quick Reference Handbook (QRH), Minimum Equipment List (MEL) and so on.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，驾驶舱内有很多手册，例如飞机飞行手册，机组操作手册，飞行运行手册，快速检查单（QRH），最低设备清单（MEL）等。

cards.audioText: What is the role of normal checklists?
cards.taskTitle: 补充话题-8
cards.audioTextZh: 正常检查单的作用是什么？
cards.referenceText: Normal checklists enhance flight safety by providing an opportunity to confirm that the safety critical aspects of the systems and aircraft configuration are correctly set. By following normal checklists, any mistakes in settings will be identified and corrected before they may cause safety problems. Normal checklist actions, as with all SOPs, are intended to check or verify actions that were accomplished from memory. A defined flow pattern should be employed for each cockpit panel. Safety-critical points should be cross-checked through the use of normal checklists.
cards.referenceTextZh: 正常检查单通过检查系统的安全关键部分和飞机配置是否设置正确来加强飞行安全。按照正常检查单，设置中出现任何错误都会在其造成安全问题前被发现并纠正。按照标准运行程序执行正常检查单是为了检查或确认是否所有记忆的项目都已经完成。驾驶舱操作面板应配备标准巡视流程。为了保证飞行安全应对正常检查单进行交叉检查。
